LanguageData.SSFTest_BearFormHediff.label: bear form
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a bear. Increased movement speed, enhanced melee hit/dodge, reduced manipulation.
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearWarriorFormHediff.label: bear warrior form
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearWarriorFormHediff.descriptio: Shapeshifted into a bear warrior. Increased movement speed, dodge, and damage reduction.
LanguageData.SSFTest_SheepFormHediff.label: sheep form
LanguageData.SSFTest_SheepFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a sheep. Reduced movement speed.
LanguageData.SSFTest_DarkKnightFormHediff.label: dark knight form
LanguageData.SSFTest_DarkKnightFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a dark knight. Reduced movement speed, increased dodge, significant damage reduction.
LanguageData.SSFTest_BeastkinFormHediff.label: beastkin form
LanguageData.SSFTest_BeastkinFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a beastkin. Increased movement speed, dodge, and melee hit chance.
LanguageData.SSFTest_FullBeastFormHediff.label: full beast form
LanguageData.SSFTest_FullBeastFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a full beast. Greatly increased movement speed, damage reduction.
LanguageData.SSFTest_GuardianFormHediff.label: guardian form
LanguageData.SSFTest_GuardianFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a guardian. Increased movement speed, damage reduction.
LanguageData.SSFTest_PhantomFormHediff.label: phantom form
LanguageData.SSFTest_PhantomFormHediff.description: Shapeshifted into a phantom. Increased movement speed.
LanguageData.SSFTest_RaceLockedFormHediff.label: race locked form
LanguageData.SSFTest_RaceLockedFormHediff.description: Human-only enhancement state. Increased movement speed, dodge, and damage reduction.
LanguageData.SSFTest_BeastArm.label: beast arm
LanguageData.SSFTest_BeastArm.description: A mutated beast arm grafted through shapeshifting.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_ShiftBlessing.label: shapeshifter's blessing
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_ShiftBlessing.description: Shapeshifter's blessing. Grants the bear warrior transformation ability while this blessing persists.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_RacialAwakening.label: racial awakening
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_RacialAwakening.descripti: Racial awakening. Grants the race-locked transformation ability while in this state. (Human only)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_GuardianMark.label: guardian's mark
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_GuardianMark.description: Guardian's mark. The guardian transformation can be maintained while this mark remains. Transformation reverts when the mark is lost.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_AutoShiftCurse.label: beast curse (auto-shift test)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_AutoShiftCurse.descriptio: Beast curse. Automatically transforms into a bear with 80% chance when it's nighttime or health drops below 30%.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_CombatAutoShift.label: combat instinct (auto-shift test)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_CombatAutoShift.descripti: Combat instinct. Automatically transforms into a bear warrior once when entering combat.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_BeastCurse.label: beast curse (permanent transform test)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_BeastCurse.description: A curse that slowly turns the victim into a bear. At severity 1.0, the transformation becomes permanent.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_CheeseCurse.label: cheese curse (thing transform test)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_CheeseCurse.description: A bizarre curse that turns the victim into cheese wheels at severity 1.0.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_WoolGrowth.label: wool growth (harvestable test)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_WoolGrowth.description: Magical wool grows on the pawn. Can be sheared when full.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_EggLaying.label: egg laying (auto-spawn test)
LanguageData.SSFTest_Hediff_EggLaying.description: Magical eggs. Female pawns automatically lay eggs on the ground.
